viewing_check: Look for a Miller/Edward Miller & Co stamp on the font, burner (EDW MILLER & CO / MILLER wheel marks) and frame collar; check the shade for cracks/chips and rim hairlines; count missing prisms; confirm font is intact (no dents/solder) and whether the electrification is reversible; check whether the loose ring belongs to the lamp.
